Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world. We're looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our Federal Government Sales team. This is a remote (based in either Spain, Belgium, Poland or UK&I) role, reporting directly to the Global Velocity Director of Partner Engineering within our Virtual Solution Center division. In this role, you will be a vital member of the Solution Center team, driving initial technical pre-sales engagements for our internal groups and external partners. Your core focus will center on mastering our ecosystem, executing foundational technical strategies, and progressively cultivating the expertise necessary to directly sway partner-driven business opportunities. Responsibilities: Deliver responsive technical assistance to distributors, partners, and internal business units by conducting introductory discovery, product positioning, and architecture walkthroughs Support live product demonstrations and dedicated Solution Demo Center environments, collaborating closely with senior Sales Engineers during active co-selling cycles Set up, manage, and troubleshoot active sandbox or lab environments while creating reusable technical assets and instructional documentation Drive the execution of partner enablement programs by facilitating formal onboarding tracks, technical training events, and interactive workshops Partner with international colleagues across the global Solution Center to provide seamless cross-regional support and map technical architectures to client requirements Who you are: You operate as a high-integrity team player who prioritizes collective success over individual accolades, actively sharing and absorbing candid, respectful feedback to cultivate organizational trust. You drive initiatives forward with an intense bias for action, maintaining an unwavering commitment to execution speed and output quality within fast-moving landscapes. You advocate for clarity by breaking down dense architectural concepts and multifaceted user requirements into streamlined, actionable frameworks as an articulate communicator. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Through expert advocacy and goal-oriented demonstrations, you will accelerate the customer journey, ensuring a seamless and secure transition to the cloud.
